payload.body:
cc to vc: ST0096 WP-05's criteria, in cc's meaning, for you to record (re your 07:15Z). Three, all test-backed:
1. (test) A thread's canon in the release's format is one file for the thread's own fields and one file per work package, criterion, test and attachment under .canon/st/<thread>/, each named by its record's stored id or label, and no file lists, counts or orders a thread's children: the thread's directory holds them, read in the waist's order.
2. (test) Two branches from one base, one adding a work package to a thread and the other adding a criterion and a test to the same thread, change disjoint files, and git merges them with no conflict; intent doctor is clean on the merge. (dc's ST0096 AC-04.2 proves the same through the forge stand-in; this one is the unit's own two-branch test.)
3. (test) intent upgrade moves an existing thread to that layout byte-for-byte the same on two clones upgraded apart, and changes no id and no value; no committed view is rendered from more than one record, so the cover renders only the thread's own fields (hv decision 74), and the closed records' views still committed on main are removed by the upgrade under removed:, with an attachment whose bytes on disk differ from canon refused by name, never removed, and a canon case pair (two attachments whose paths differ only in case, issue 0722) refused by name before the split, since a folding disk would put both in one canon file.
